story:
Prezkop Builders is a licensed custom finish contractor in the Wyoming Valley, Pennsylvania area, specializing in outdoor living spaces and remodeling. From deck and porch remodels and new construction, to full home remodels and floor refinishing, we can do it all. From beginning to end, our level of white-glove renovation services provides the attention, skill and expertise needed to take your project from just another room or space to an exquisite and stylish addition to your home.

Josh Prezkop started the company in April 2021. Hardwood floor refinishing came first — it is still done by Josh and his father, and it is still the work that taught the rest of the business what "finished" is supposed to mean. Outdoor living came next: decks, covered porches, pavilions, pergolas, and decorative and stamped concrete patios. Then whole-home remodels, additions and ground-up new construction, plus the pre-construction planning that keeps all of it from turning into a series of expensive surprises.

Five years in, it is still a three-person crew — Josh, Jake and Jimmy. We strive to attain overall client satisfaction and encourage honest feedback, clear and consistent communication, job site safety, and honesty and integrity when it comes to workmanship and client relations. We strive to complete every job on schedule and as close to budget as possible, from the initial design phase through project completion. We are confident in our craftsmanship and take pride in the work we do, and we would rather you tell us mid-project that something is not right than find out about it in a review.
